title: View
description: Host-neutral view compute document. COMPUTE, not a wire message: a view is never a Snapshot, a Delta, or a distinct IPC kind. It is not a widget tree and not a pixel layout. Install, outside this document, lowers a signal to a Source, an expression to a guarded Computed, an effect to an Effect, and the optional chart to one cell. Conformance asserts resolved signals, expression values, the effect trace, and abstract layout — not pixels, focus, IME, gestures, or the accessibility tree.

root.description: Id of the root node. Every other node is reachable from it through children.

signals.description: Signal id to its declaration. A signal installs as a Source.

nodes.description: Node id to its declaration. Ids are the object keys.

chart.description: Optional statechart document installed as one cell beside the view. send effects deliver events to it.

initial.description: Initial value. Null, boolean, integer, or string. No objects, arrays, or non-integer numbers.

role.description: Semantic role. Widget, host, and toolkit names are not roles.

children.description: Ordered child node ids. The tree is ordered by this array, not by object-key order.

text.description: A literal string or an expression. Installs as a guarded Computed.

bind.description: Signal id this field reads. The signal must be declared. A change event does not write it unless an effect does.

hidden.description: Boolean literal or an expression that evaluates to a boolean.

disabled.description: Boolean literal or an expression that evaluates to a boolean.

Layout.description: Abstract layout. No pixels, no coordinates, no host units.

align.description: Abstract cross-axis alignment. Not a pixel offset.

grow.description: Abstract flex grow factor. Not a pixel size.

Effects.description: Semantic events only. Host names such as onClick and onPressed are rejected.

Expr.description: Expression tree. No host closures. op is closed; args are literals or expressions. call names are the closed set event, not, add, and len.

Effect.description: Effect tree. set writes a signal, send delivers a chart event, batch runs nested effects in order. The conformance trace records set and send only; batch flattens.
